fields.title: Hand-Carved Wooden Domino Set
fields.description: Classic domino set hand-carved from Egyptian wood. Durable and perfect for family gatherings or friendly matches.

fields.title: Papyrus Puzzle Game
fields.description: Unique jigsaw puzzle made from papyrus prints featuring traditional Egyptian artwork. Fun and educational for kids and adults.

fields.title: Handmade Camel Plush Toy
fields.description: Soft plush toy shaped like a camel, handmade with Egyptian cotton. A cuddly and safe companion for kids.

fields.title: Traditional Senet Board Game
fields.description: Replica of the ancient Egyptian board game Senet. Wooden board with hand-painted hieroglyphs and carved pieces.

fields.title: Wooden Spinning Top (Toupie)
fields.description: Traditional Egyptian wooden spinning top. Hand-painted with vibrant colors, perfect for hours of play.

fields.title: Handwoven Puppet Doll
fields.description: Colorful handwoven fabric puppet doll inspired by Egyptian folk art. Great for storytelling and playtime.

fields.title: Mini Pyramid Building Blocks
fields.description: Wooden building block set shaped like pyramids. Encourages creativity and fine motor skills in children.

fields.title: Clay Animal Figurines
fields.description: Set of hand-molded clay figurines of Egyptian animals like camels, cats, and donkeys. Fun and educational toy.

fields.title: Khan El Khalili Marble Game
fields.description: Traditional marble game inspired by Khan El Khalili market toys. Comes with glass marbles in a handmade pouch.

fields.title: Cairo Chess Set
fields.description: Elegant chess set inspired by Cairo’s architecture. Hand-carved wooden pieces with Egyptian motifs.
